text: Onions and garlic are essential in adding depth and flavor to any dish, particularly in vegetable stews and soups. To prepare onions and garlic for this purpose, chop them into small pieces. Then, heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Once heated, add the chopped onions and garlic to the skillet. Allow them to cook for about 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they have softened slightly.
